params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} {{ci|Diana}} gains {{as|{{sti|attack speed}}}}, increased shortly after casting an ability.
params.blurb2: Every third basic attack in quick succession will cleave nearby enemies, dealing {{as|magic damage}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Diana''' gains {{as|{{sti|attack speed|{{pplevel|15 to 35|key=%}} '''bonus''' attack speed}}}}. After casting an {{tip|ability}}, this bonus is tripled to {{pplevel|15*3 to 35*3|key=%|color=as}} for 5 seconds.
params.description2: {{sbc|Innate - Moonsilver Blade:}} '''Diana's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} generate a {{tip|stack}}  of ''Moonsilver Blade'' for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent attacks and stacking up to 2 times. At 2 stacks, '''Diana''' empowers her next basic attack to consume the stacks {{tip|on-hit}} to additionally cleave nearby enemies, dealing them {{pplevel|20+5*(x-1) for 6; then + 10*x for 5; then + 15*x for 5; then + 25*x|formula=20 + 5 per level until level 6, then + 10 per level until level 11, then + 15 per level until level 16, then + 25 per level|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}} {{as|magic damage}}. ''Moonsilver Blade'' deals 270% damage against {{tip|monsters}}.
params.notes:
* ''Moonsilver Blade'' will affect {{tip|structures}}.
* Each attack has a distinct animation and she will glow when the empowered attack is ready.
* When the stacks are consumed {{tip|on-hit}} (e.g {{ii|Guinsoo's Rageblade}}, {{ii|Dusk and Dawn}}), additional damage is only applied to the on-hit target, without triggering the cleave on nearby enemies. [https://www.reddit.com/r/DianaMains/comments/u7hlez/guinsoos_rageblade_interaction_with_dianas/]
* Sometimes, the empowered basic attack will not consume the stacks.{{bug|1}}
** In this case, the attack will also not deal its damage.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Diana}} unleashes a bolt of lunar energy that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit in an arc before exploding at the target location.
params.blurb2: Enemies hit are marked with ''Moonlight'', {{tip|sight|revealing}} them.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Diana''' unleashes a bolt of lunar energy that travels in a counter-clockwise arc before exploding at the target location, granting {{tip|sight}} of the area for {{fd|0.5}} seconds and dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and afflicting them with ''Moonlight'' for 3 seconds, during which they are {{tip|standard sight|revealed}}.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Diana}} {{tip|shield|shields}} herself, creating three orbiting spheres that detonate on contact with enemies to deal {{as|magic damage}} in an area.
params.blurb2: If all the spheres detonate, she gains more {{tip|shield}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Diana''' grants herself a {{tip|shield}} for up to 5 seconds and creates three spheres that orbit her counterclockwise for the same duration, each detonating upon contact with an enemy to deal {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.
params.leveling:
{{st|Shield Strength|{{ap|45 to 105}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}} {{as|(+ 14% '''bonus''' health)}}}}
{{st|Magic Damage per Orb|{{ap|20 to 68}} {{as|(+ 18% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|20*3 to 68*3}} {{as|(+ 54% AP)}}}}
params.description2: If all three spheres detonate, ''Pale Cascade's'' shield is reapplied, stacking with its original shield and refreshing the duration.
params.notes:
* On the second application of ''Pale Cascade's'' shield, {{sti|Shield Power|link = Heal and shield power}} will apply to both the new shield amount and the shield amount remaining from the first shield, which has already benefited from ''shield power''.
** Because of this, ''shield power'' effectively applies to the second shield twice, but with reduced efficiency, for up to an increase of 50% of ''shield power'' (maximum benefit if no damage was mitigated by the first shield). With 10% ''shield power'', the second shield's total amount will be increased by up to an additional 5%, for a total of {{tt|{{fd|15.5%}}|1.1*1.05}} '''bonus''' shield.
** The formula for the total amount of shield '''Diana''' will receive from both shield applications is:
*** ''Total Shield = (((Shield Amount × (1 + Shield Power)) - Damage Blocked by Shield) + Shield Amount) × (1 + Shield Power)''

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Diana}} {{tip|dash|dashes}} to an enemy and deals {{as|magic damage}}.
params.blurb2: If used on a target afflicted with {{ai|Crescent Strike|Diana|''Moonlight''}}, the cooldown is massively {{sti|ah|reduced}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Diana''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target enemy's location, and upon completion, she deals them {{as|magic damage}} and consumes ''{{ai|Crescent Strike|Diana|Moonlight}}'' from all enemies. If the target is within 400 range, '''Diana''' will dash through their location.
params.description2: If ''Moonlight'' is consumed from the target, ''Lunar Rush's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is reduced to {{fd|0.25}} seconds.
params.description3: '''''Diana''' can cast any of her abilities during the dash.''
params.notes:
* '''Diana''' will attempt to basic attack the target.
* ''Lunar Rush's'' cooldown will also be reset if the target dies during the dash while being affected by ''Moonlight''.
* ''Lunar Rush'' consumes ''Moonlight'' upon ending the dash (even if {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}}).
* ''Lunar Rush'' will still deal damage even if the target is {{tip|untargetable}} by the end of the dash.
* If ''Lunar Rush'' is blocked by {{tip|spell shield}} the ''Moonlight'' debuff is still consumed but ''Lunar Rush's'' cooldown is not reset.
params.tips:
* Since ''Moonlight'' is consumed upon ending the dash, a {{ai|Crescent Strike|Diana}} cast mid-dash can still cause a reset.
* ''Lunar Rush'' only consumes present ''Moonlight'' from the enemies. Because of this, it is possible for ''Lunar Rush'' to be reset multiple times during the same ''Crescent Strike'' cast, until it finishes its trajectory.

params.blurb2: If she pulls an enemy {{tip|champion}}, she calls down a beam of moonlight to strike upon the area after a delay, dealing {{as|magic damage}}, increased if she pulled more champions.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Diana''' {{tip|airborne|pulls}} all nearby enemies towards her, during which they are {{tip|standard sight|revealed}}, then {{tip|slow|slows}} them for 2 seconds.
params.description2: If an enemy {{tip|champion}} is pulled, she calls down a beam of moonlight to strike upon the area around her after 1 second, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to all nearby enemies, increased for each champion pulled beyond the first.
params.leveling2:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|200 to 400}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Damage Per Champion|{{ap|35 to 85}} {{as|(+ 15% AP)}}|Total Damage Vs. 5 Champions|{{ap|200+35*4 to 400+85*4}} {{as|(+ 120% AP)}}}}
params.notes:
* Enemies stay in the area for a maximum of approximately {{fd|0.5}} seconds while being pulled.
* {{tip|cc-immune|Crowd control immunity}} and {{tip|displacement immunity}} still count as being "pulled in" by the ability.
* {{tip|clone|Clones}} count as champions for increasing this ability's damage.
* ''Moonfall's'' additional damage is not capped at 4 champions.
* The beam of moonlight does not crash down if champions hit blocked the initial effect with {{tip|spell shield}}.
** Enemy champions protected by ''spell shield'' do not count towards the damage increase.
{{Effect at cast time end}}
* A lunar phase of the moon will appear above '''Diana''' while she is casting ''Moonfall'', each phase is based on the number of enemy {{tip|champion|champions}} pulled:
